_doc: POI dungeon mechanics tuning (ADR-0018, ADR-0022, docs/POI_AUTHORING.md). Distances in metres, times in seconds, noise = Stimuli loudness (metres at which a normal listener just hears it; >= 20 also feeds the heat map). Yields are items handed over by a crouched disarm (poi.disarm_trap); 'salvage' is what a sprung trap still gives. Each trap's 'hollowed' block says how the Hollowed set it off (see 'hollowed' below).

ambush._doc: Grouped (held) sleepers ignore ordinary noise, light and proximity until a trigger of their group fires; then they wake one after another, alerted to the player. Only these sound kinds within wake_radius wake them early.

unspawned._doc: A trigger or a loud trap that goes off while the building's sleepers are not spawned (the Hum breaking a door far from the player, a wanderer in a can chime) is spent all the same, and rouses who would have woken: the trigger's group, everyone for an alarm the player set off, and for noise the ordinary sleepers within loudness x hearing (held ones only for wake_kinds within the ambush wake_radius). Roused sleepers are saved (WorldState.pois[id].roused) and spawn awake by their post next time, heading for where it happened.

guardian._doc: Guardians spawn this many infected tiers above their roll (normal -> Seeded -> Bloomed).

sleepers._doc: Posed sleepers on seats and beds (ADR-0022, SleeperAnchors). reach: how far a sit/lie sleeper looks for a free seat or bed from where it is authored (twice that for a pinned 'anchor'); exclusive: anchors of one prop closer than this exclude each other (a bench's two facings); facing_cost: metres added per 180 deg an anchor faces away from the sleeper's authored rot. seat_height / seat_back: where idle_sleep_seat puts the pelvis above and behind its feet (keep in step with char_anim SEAT_H / SEAT_Y); lie_back / sit_back: char_anim LIE_Y / SIT_Y (a lying body; one sat legs out on a low seat); max_sink: how far a seat lower than seat_height may sink the feet; mattress_sink: how far a lying body presses into the bedding; seat_side_step: how far a sitter shuffles sideways out of a booth. Getting up runs over rise_seconds: the body moves to its exit over *_move and turns over bed_turn (fractions of it).

hollowed._doc: How the Hollowed set traps off (ADR-0022). weights: weight class per enemy id (others weigh default_weight). A trap reacts to a Hollowed whose class is at least its hollowed.min_weight (no min_weight: never); hollowed.fires_trigger says whether that fires the trap's ambush triggers. A trap a Hollowed sets off makes its noise through the stimulus fields: sleepers wake by hearing it; only the player's misstep alerts them directly or sets off an alarm's building-wide rouse.

shotgun._doc: A sawn-off charge: 'pellets' rays from the muzzle, spread uniformly within spread_deg (half angle) of the aim, deterministic per trap. Walls, props and the first body in the way stop a pellet. Each pellet carries damage / pellets (enemy_damage / pellets against the Hollowed), falling off linearly from full at 'near' to nothing at 'far'; one body takes all its pellets as one hit. The wire pulls the trigger pull_seconds after it is caught.

hollowed._doc: The boards groan under the Hollowed too: a sound cue for the player only (no noise for the Hollowed, the trap does not count as fired, its ambush stays armed for the player).
Only the heavy ones break through; they fall to the room below and take fall_damage.
A Hollowed that blunders through rings it like anyone; the ringing wakes sleepers by stimulus (held ambushes only within the ambush wake_radius) instead of rousing the whole building.

vault._doc: Vault doors (lock 'vault', ADR-0026): every blow on one is a screech of steel heard this far (m) as an alarm, and the first blow a player lands rouses the whole building. Its hit points are the opening's 'hp'.

padlock._doc: Breakable lock cues on locked doors: hit points per kind (deadbolts and bolts cannot be broken off; bash the door).

route_cues._doc: Route cues on windows (ADR-0022, RouteCues): every window the validated route climbs in through gets 'default'; an opening's own "cue" (a kind, a list, or "none") overrides it. crate: the prop stood under the window outside (two stacked when the sill is more than crate_high above the ground); scuff_decal / sill_decal: decal ids for the boot scuffs up the wall and the handprint on the sill; light_prop: the lantern a "light" cue leaves burning on the sill (its light: PropDef.light_for), at most max_lights per building.
